title: Moses' burning bush as a plasmoid

tellings.quote: Moses speaking to the burning bush could be like a plasmoid or whatever that's, you know, kind of a modern UFO encounter.

plain: Michels suggests that the biblical story of Moses speaking to a burning bush could have been a plasmoid, a glowing mass of electrically charged gas, and so a kind of modern UFO encounter. He draws the idea from the writer Robert Temple's book A New Science of Heaven, as a way of reading old religious visions as the same thing people now report.
